text:
Riley: Heads upseeing a burst of TLS handshake failures for service-proxy in eu-west-1 starting ~09:02 UTC. Errors indicate KMS decrypt denies.
Priya: Yep saw the alert. Sample log: `unwrap failed: KMS AccessDenied: Decrypt denied -> assumed-role/proxy-keystore`
Diego: I rolled a policy change last evening to tighten KMS scopes (added aws:SourceVpc condition) for a couple of helper roles. I did not intend to touch proxy-keystore.
Theo: If the change targeted the shared key policy document rather than the helper role it could affect all assumed roles referencing that key. Do we have the exact policy ARN that was updated?
Diego: change-id pc-2026-421, policy arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-... updated at 2026-03-21T01:10:12Z. I pushed it via infra/iam pipeline.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 created and routed to eng-security.
Riley: Short-term mitigations proposed: (A) revert the policy change (fast), (B) enable keystore in-memory cache fallback for 10m (risky), (C) promote a regional KMS key and switch EU proxies to it (longer).
Priya: Revert + short cache window seems reasonable. We explicitly disabled cache-on-deny previously to avoid silent key drift; if we use it temporarily we should make it operator-controlled and instrumented.
Diego: I'm reverting now. Posting revert id in a sec.
Theo: Also add richer request context to KMS calls so CloudTrail contains application context. Right now CloudTrail shows Decrypt deny but it's hard to link to a specific proxy request. We should pass `EncryptionContext` keys like `service`, `route`, and `session`.
Riley: Runbook additions: include this CloudWatch Logs Insights query for quick deny lookup:
```
filter @message like /Decrypt/ and @message like /AccessDenied/
| parse @message /user (arn:aws:sts::\d+:assumed-role\/([^\s]+))/ as role
| stats count() by role, bin(1m)
| sort by count desc
| limit 50
```
Priya: I'll flip the operator flag to allow a 5m cache window after revert completes. Also adding a temporary alert: `kms.decrypt.denies > 5 in 1m` correlated with `proxy.tls.handshake.failures > 20` should page ENGSEC.
Diego: Revert applied: revert-pc-2026-421 at 09:07:42 UTC. Keystore decrypt success rate improving.
Riley: Confirming TLS handshakes back to normal in eu-west-1. Monitoring for 45m.
Theo: Post-incident follow-ups: (1) IAM change checklist that requires verifying affected trust principals and cross-region egress paths, (2) CI policy lint that simulates denies for known service principals, (3) telemetry: emit `iam.policy.rollout{role=\"...\", change_id=\"...\"}` metric on deploy.
Priya: Logging followups: TOOLING-923 (CloudTrail query snippets), INFRA-2199 (keystore cache operator flag), ENGSEC-3580 (policy audit / postmortem).
Diego: Sorry team, intended to reduce blast radius. I'll add a preflight step to the pipeline to run the policy emulator against a matrix of assumed-roles and source VPCs.
Riley: Good. Also add an automated smoke test that runs a sample decrypt from each region after KMS policy changes before rolling to prod.
Priya: Will file the smoke test and add it to the deploy guard. For the postmortem we should capture timeline, exact policy diff, and CloudTrail samples.
Riley: Closing for now once we hit the 45m monitor window. Thanks for the quick rollback. :thumbsup:
